description: An address's confirmed balance by day, week or month, with what came in and went out in each and how many transactions did each. Without an API key at most 2,000 points (daily: the most recent days unless from says otherwise); with one, 20,000.

from.description: Optional start: unix seconds, a date like 2025-12-31 (UTC) or a timestamp like 2025-12-31T23:59:59Z.

network.description: Network: BTC, LTC, DOGE, ZEC, BTCTEST, LTCTEST, DOGETEST or ZECTEST.

to.description: Optional end (a date means its last second): unix seconds, a date like 2025-12-31 (UTC) or a timestamp like 2025-12-31T23:59:59Z.

name: get_balance_history
title: Address Balance History
